record.question: Grievous hurt includes all the following except :
options: Privation of any member or joint
Inability to follow one's ordinary pursuits for a period of a week
record.explanation: Answer D: Inability to follow one's ordinary pursuits for a period of a week. Section 116 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 defines grievous hurt to include inability to follow ordinary pursuits for fifteen days (the section took effect with the BNS on 1 July 2024). A one-week period is shorter, so this option is the exception under the law current for this 2026 paper. The printed question may preserve earlier IPC-era wording; its option still does not meet the current statutory threshold. Source/context note: Exam-date anchor: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, section 116 (effective 1 July 2024); do not cite IPC 20-day wording as current. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/20062/1/a2023-45.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
